endorsements.name: Erlaitz Parreño Muñoz
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-10355
endorsements.description: Open redirection vulnerability in MOLGENIS EMX2 v11.14.0. This vulnerability allows an attacker to create a malicious URL using a manipulated redirection parameter, potentially leading users to phishing sites or other malicious destinations via “/%2f%2f<MALICIOUS_DOMAIN>”.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.1)

endorsements.name: Erlaitz Parreño Muñoz
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-40649
endorsements.description: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Biobanking and Biomolecular Resources Negotiator v3.15.2 - European Research Infrastructure (BBMRI-ERIC), consisting of a stored XSS due to a lack of proper validation of user input by sending a POST request using parameter text in '/api/v3/negotiations/<postUID>/posts'. This vulnerability could allow a remote user to send a specially crafted query to an authenticated user and steal their cookie session details.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.1)

endorsements.name: Erlaitz Parreño Muñoz
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-40676
endorsements.description: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) in Negotiator v3.15.2 from Biobanking and Biomolecular Resources - European Research Infrastructure (BBMRI-ERIC). This vulnerability allows an attacker to access or modify unauthorised resources by manipulating requests that use the 'userID' parameter in '/api/v3/users/<userID>', which may result in the exposure or alteration of sensitive data
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.3)
